observation_limits: Browser observations cover the in-app browser, desktop and phone viewports, search and mobile navigation; no cross-browser matrix is claimed.
Deployed pages retain the reviewed pre-closeout wording, including hosted integration pending. A later documentation closeout has separate deployment evidence.

Automated review scope is the exact commit recorded in review_coverage. Any subsequent four-line CI-only test-selection addition is reviewed by the primary; no final-head automated approval is inferred.
The accepted premerge Full43 remains the query regression observation; no query rerun was used for merge or deployment proof.
Published 0.6.0 packages remain immutable; installed-wheel proofs are CI builds, not a new package publication.
